newsitem.title: UK: M.STANLEY MAKES LUXEMBOURG CUSTODY HIRE.
newsitem.headline: M.STANLEY MAKES LUXEMBOURG CUSTODY HIRE.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Morgan Stanley said on Monday it had appointed Alan Skinner as head of Morgan Stanley Bank Luxembourg SA.
Morgan Stanley said Skinner was previously managing director at Bankers Trust, where he was in charge of global securities services and based in Edinburgh. Before that he worked for Citibank.
At Morgan Stanley Bank Luxembourg Skinner will be responsible for global custody and administration. He will report to David Newman, chief operating officer for European global custody.
Morgan Stanley said Morgan Stanley Bank Luxembourg was the largest custodian in Luxembourg, servicing custodied assets of more than $25 billion.
